notes:
A backup file that copies but will not upload is left alone, and the office can salvage what still reads.

- Resume will not overwrite a full-size backup file that will not read in the middle — even if a card is seated
- Tools → Advanced → Salvage a backup file copies what still reads onto a new file, then sends the log and that file to SafeStore Diagnostics (not the couple folder)
- Upload pending names the parked clip when one file is stuck
- Resume after Stop is more reliable, and a backup drive that is still connected is less likely to be called unplugged
